author: SickProdigy
description: Query an AzerothCore SOAP endpoint for server info, online players, and account creation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration such as API endpoint settings and allowed role IDs. It does not persist user-provided account data.
install_msg: This cog contacts the configured AzerothCore SOAP service and bundles a status banner image. Configure the endpoint with `[p]azerothcore set soap_url <ip:port>`, SOAP credentials with `[p]azerothcore set soap_auth <user> <pass>`, and allowed account-creation roles with `[p]azerothcore set accountcreationrole <role...>`. Use `[p]help azerothcore set` for the remaining server settings.
name: AzerothCore
short: Interact with an AzerothCore server through SOAP
